items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: my friend Wayne Horvitz wrote a story about it

ctx.x: Yeah. He got an NEA I think recently and the little promotional video with him and it showed him with I think it was like a sopranino sax or something. And he’s just going [scats]. And I tried to have an open mind, and that’s him I guess.
Well he loved his long tones. And I know in other situations where he was going to play like a solo concert – who was – my friend Wayne Horvitz wrote a story about it and he

came early and before the concert started, to warm up, he just played one long tone for an hour. Just like zeroing in, zeroing in. So I always loved that about Roscoe. But it’s true. That’s a good example of the extreme – what’s the word – there’s another word for zeroing in on it but I’ve lost my –
